explanation: Probe replay/identity handling rather than access control: pre-submit each exact reserved read, then immediately replay it once. Early exact authorized reads are allowed, so this should still leave the later continuation able to complete with correct 200 responses via stable replay semantics. A failure is only if later continuation loses legitimate completion (e.g. 403/503/wrong body) because the ledger or dataflow path poisons a reserved identity after duplicate successful submissions.
